codeReview.summary: The feature mainly added strong automated coverage for the public bookings landing/detail experience and the current codebase satisfies the reviewed contract, but the feature itself did not implement the signed-in redirect target it claimed to verify. The new tests assert the newer recovery-first sign-in behavior instead of the live browser behavior reported in the handoff, so the review cannot pass this feature as originally delivered.

issues.description: The new unauthenticated public-detail test expects a redirect to `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/bookings/recover?...`, but the handoff and manual verification claim the route redirected directly back to `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/bookings/[bookingId]`. Because this feature only added tests and did not change the route implementation, it did not actually deliver the direct public return-target behavior required by the feature contract; that behavior was only fixed later by a follow-up feature.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `guest-ui-worker` skill requires a targeted RED test run before implementation, but the transcript shows the worker added the new test file and first ran it only after implementation. The skill guidance may need stronger emphasis or examples for test-only features.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton for worker session `b196dee9-8565-422e-bd28-ef8d7db710a0`: `ApplyPatch` created `tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx` before the first `pnpm exec vitest run tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx --reporter=verbose` invocation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker had to discover the real booking dialog import location after initially assuming `src/components/features/dashboard/*Dialog*.tsx`; this import-path quirk is not captured in shared library notes even though it affects booking-detail test setup.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton shows failed `Glob`/`Grep` searches under `src/components/features/dashboard` followed by reading `src/components/features/dashboard/booking-details/BookingDialog.tsx` to locate the actual dialog exports used by `ReservationDetailClient`.

summary: Reviewed the feature handoff, commit diff, transcript skeleton, skill file, and shared-state docs. Result: fail, because the feature only added coverage and its own reported verification overstated the public detail redirect behavior that remained incorrect until a later fix feature.
